name: Heimdall
title: Bifrost Warden
summary: Defend the bifrost against marauding invaders and protect the halls of asgard from harm!
lore: The sentinel of Bifrost, Heimdall has long guarded Asgard against danger—yet now the entire world is a threat. He does not know how the Shattering could have happened without him spotting some warning, some trace. That lack of understanding, and what he views as a failure of his duties, spur him to new efforts that may exhaust even his divine endurance.
